beats.summary: Michael is accused of damaging Holly's gift, leading to a tense confrontation about jealousy and relationships.

evidence.snippet: Holly (walks in with a dirty Woody): Who did this? It's obvious to me I'm not welcome here, but somebody better tell me who did this, or else I'm leaving.
Michael: All right. Shh. Okay, you know what? Holly, I didn't mean to do it. It was an accident. An accident borne of jealous feelings.

beats.summary: Michael reveals the damaged Woody was a prank as part of the party.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Ahhhhhh! Surprise! It was part of the party. Pretty funny, huh?

beats.summary: Michael expresses his feelings about Holly's new relationship and their past.

evidence.snippet: Michael: When you got transferred, and I drove you up to Nashua, you said, "Michael, I love you, but I can't do this." But then, with this other guy, you don't have any problem with a long-distance relationship, do you?

beats.summary: Pam enlists Darryl and Jada to help find the stolen Christmas star in the warehouse.

evidence.snippet: Pam: Jada, Darryl, I'm so glad I found you guys. A grinch stole the star from on top of the Christmas tree and is hiding it in the warehouse somewhere.
Andy: I am the mean old grinch. The little girl who wishes to win back the Christmas star must first succeed at these challenges.

beats.summary: Various characters exchange Christmas gifts and greetings.

evidence.snippet: Jim (walks over to his desk and sees a present sitting on it, reading the note): "Hey, Pickles, Merry Christmas. Open immediately. Love, Swiss Cheese." Damn it, Dwight!
Darryl (handing out vending machine items to everyone): Merry Christmas.
